[P2] Attempt forced cleanup when graceful shutdown throws

If an owned executor's `shutdown()` throws before stopping its workers, this catch returns without attempting `shutdownNow()`. Normal finalization then sets `cleanupFinished`, preventing automatic close from retrying, while the running pool and its static identity lease remain retained. Unlike initialization cleanup, this path can leak a pool on every affected invocation. Attempt a forced stop and await termination within the remaining budget, preserving the original failure. Add a regression test whose `shutdown()` throws before delegating but whose `shutdownNow()` succeeds.
